{{unknown name}} {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} [[File:Oleana subordinate.png|thumb|250px|Oleana's subordinate]] '''Oleana's subordinate''' (Japanese: '''オリーヴの部下''' ''Olive's subordinate'') is a [[Macro Cosmos]] {{tc|Macro Cosmos's|employee}} who works under [[Oleana]]. ==In animation== ===History=== Oleana's subordinate is a recurring character in {{aniseries|JN}}. He debuted at the end of ''[[JN042|Sword and Shield, Slumbering Weald!]]'', where he was following [[Goh]] and [[Sonia]]'s car. In ''[[JN043|Sword and Shield: The Darkest Day!]]'', he continued to follow Goh and Sonia as they visited the geoglyph on the hill outside [[Turffield]], as well as [[Professor Magnolia]] at her laboratory in [[Wedgehurst]]. After speaking to Oleana, he confronted the pair at [[Stow-on-Side]] while they were visiting the ancient mural and sent out his [[Gigantamax]] {{p|Garbodor}}. Goh [[Dynamax]]ed his {{TP|Goh|Raboot}} and proceeded to battle Garbodor, accidentally destroying the mural in the process. In ''[[JN044|Sword and Shield: "From Here to Eternatus!"]]'', Goh and Raboot managed to defeat his Garbodor despite its Gigantamax form. He retreated to get aid from other {{tc|Macro Cosmos's|Macro Cosmos employees}}, only for Raboot to kick them all aside to allow Goh and Sonia to escape. He and the other employees later confronted Sonia in front of the [[Hammerlocke Stadium]], only for [[Raihan]] to appear to defend her. In [[JN045|the next episode]], he and the other employees were easily defeated by Raihan's {{p|Duraludon}}, forcing them to withdraw. ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} This listing is of Oleana's subordinate's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Oleana's subordinate |pkmn=Garbodor |giga=yes |type1=Poison |img=Subordinate Garbodor.png |img2=Subordinate Gigantamax Garbodor.png |epnum=JN043 |epname=Sword and Shield: The Darkest Day! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Garbodor}} was sent out to battle [[Goh]] and [[Sonia]] while they were visiting the ancient mural at [[Stow-on-Side]]. Garbodor [[Gigantamax]]ed and took on Goh's [[Dynamax]]ed {{TP|Goh|Raboot}}. None of Garbodor's moves are known{{tt|*|Garbodor is implied to know a Poison-type and Steel-type attack due to the use of G-Max Malodor and Max Steelspike, respectively}}.
As a Gigantamax Garbodor, it can use {{m|G-Max Malodor}} and {{m|Max Steelspike}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Macro Cosmos |pkmn=Durant |type1=Bug |type2=Steel |img=Subordinate Durant.png |epnum=JN044 |epname=Sword and Shield: "From Here to Eternatus!" |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Durant}} was sent out to confront [[Sonia]], only for [[Raihan]] to appear and send out his {{p|Duraludon}}, which easily defeated it.
